EmailTemplate.name: TAL SLA Expired
EmailTemplate.subject: Please log a call or email task on your pending TAL lead
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} assigned to you with a lead stage of "TAL", and Lead Status of “accepted” has eclipsed the maximum allowed SLA time with no initial task logged. Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
As a reminder, the following SLA’s are expected for any TAL lead owned by you: (<Lead Priority> = Hot): Initial Task (Email or Phone Call) must be logged within 1 business day of Entrance Date (<Lead Priority> = Warm): Initial Task (Email or Phone Call) must be logged within 2 business days of Entrance Date (<Lead Priority> = Cold): Initial Task (Email or Phone Call) must be logged within 4 business days of Entrance Date Please disposition your lead by completing the required email or phone call task or mark the Lead Status as “disqualified” or “unreachable” as required. Thank you.
